description: ANTHARIKSH is an initiative driven by my passion for space exploration, technology, and innovation. As a Computer Science student interested in AI/ML, Python, and space technology, I aim to turn satellite data into meaningful insights through the Dancing with the SARs challenge. I am looking for passionate, creative, and collaborative individuals skilled in Python, GIS, remote sensing, machine learning, and data visualization to join me on this journey.
summary:
ANTHARIKSH is a satellite-based Earth observation and change detection platform developed to monitor and visualize changes occurring on Earth's surface using Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data. The platform allows users to explore geographical regions, compare satellite observations across different time periods, and identify changes such as urban expansion, vegetation loss, and land-use transformations.

Our solution provides an interactive web-based dashboard with geographical visualization, before-and-after comparisons, change detection results, and analytical insights. By leveraging SAR technology, the platform demonstrates how satellite-based monitoring can support Earth observation even under cloudy conditions and limited visibility.

ANTHARIKSH addresses the challenge of making satellite data more accessible, understandable, and useful for monitoring environmental and urban changes. It is important because timely identification of land-surface changes can support urban planning, environmental conservation, disaster management, and sustainable development.
details:
1. What does the project do and how does it work?

ANTHARIKSH is a satellite-based Earth observation platform that demonstrates how Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) technology can be used to identify and visualize changes on Earth's surface. Users can explore geographical regions, compare observations across different time periods, and view changes such as urban expansion and vegetation loss through an interactive dashboard.

2. What are its benefits?

It simplifies satellite data visualization, helps monitor environmental and urban changes, and demonstrates the potential of SAR technology in cloudy conditions.

3. What is its intended impact?

To support environmental conservation, sustainable urban planning, disaster preparedness, and better understanding of Earth's changing surface.

4. What tools and technologies were used?

  • Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.
  • Frontend: React.js, Tailwind CSS.
  • Backend: Node.js, Express.js.
  • Tools: VS Code, GitHub, Vercel.

5. How is the project creative?

It transforms complex satellite observation concepts into an interactive, user-friendly platform with geographical visualization, before-and-after comparisons, and change statistics.

6. What factors did the team consider?

Data accessibility, SAR technology, visualization clarity, environmental relevance, user experience, and future scalability.
